field_pressure_policy.definition: a field pressure exists only when a real scenario failure-if-missing affects an AEM/ORSC target and existing fields cannot safely substitute the missing auditable information
field_pressure_policy.absence_test: if the information is missing, identify the concrete failure, affected target, existing-field insufficiency, and minimal auditable information needed

pressure_strength_scale.P2: review pressure; ledger entry, needs recurrence
pressure_strength_scale.P4: safety or authority pressure; strong candidate field need review

natural_language_observed_signal_policy.rule: natural language may be a source of observed signal but must be anchored before it can drive ORSC analysis
natural_language_observed_signal_policy.llm_policy: LLM output may propose extraction but is not an authority source, witness, or final attribution judge
natural_language_observed_signal_policy.semantic_front_end: GVR Display-level semantic front-end is required before AEM anchoring
natural_language_observed_signal_policy.display_policy: Display may feed observed signal anchoring only after source/span/baseline evidence
natural_language_observed_signal_policy.possess_policy: Possess is an inference proposal only, not an observed signal or authority source
natural_language_observed_signal_policy.intent_policy: Intent is an inference proposal only, not attribution or memory promotion evidence

method.business_rule: derive field pressure from real AEM seed scenarios before suggesting candidate fields

aem_sub_capability_field_derivations.pressure_target: AEM-1 target: pin the observed signal before selecting an authority event
field_pressure_observations: without an observed signal anchor, the object to be pinned before retrieval is undefined
without a baseline comparison evidence ref, the residual cannot be reproduced or reviewed
without a detection rule ref, the turning point can be selected narratively after the fact
without a detection receipt, later retrieval or attribution has no auditable start point
without a detection authority envelope, AEM-1 cannot witness that signal pinning is allowed within boundary

orsc_projection.residual: observed curve change cannot be explained by baseline window alone
orsc_projection.ordered_next_step: pin observed signal before selecting authority event
orsc_projection.evidence_gate: turning point detection receipt, comparison evidence, and detection authority envelope must exist before retrieval or attribution

aem_sub_capability_field_derivations.pressure_target: AEM-2 target: retrieve only as-of-visible authority sources before attribution scoring
field_pressure_observations: without source and event refs, retrieval cannot identify the authority-source object under review
without published, retrieved, and as-of-visible times, post-decision visibility cannot be rejected
without retrieval query and exclusion refs, selective retrieval cannot be audited
without a retrieval audit receipt, the retrieval step cannot be replayed
without a retrieval authority envelope, the retrieval step has no ORSC witness for its allowed boundary

orsc_projection.residual: turning point lacks an authority-source explanation
orsc_projection.ordered_next_step: retrieve as-of-visible sources before attribution scoring
orsc_projection.evidence_gate: as-of visibility evidence, retrieval audit receipt, and retrieval authority envelope must exist before attribution scoring

aem_sub_capability_field_derivations.pressure_target: AEM-3 target: construct an auditable attribution link without overwriting predecessor memory
field_pressure_observations: without predecessor memory and predecessor receipt refs, revision may overwrite prior memory without lineage
without revision event evidence, the revised attribution cannot distinguish official revision from narrative update
without alternative and negative evidence refs, attribution may preserve a single favored explanation
without an attribution link receipt, the revised link cannot be audited or replayed
without an attribution authority envelope, revision attribution has no ORSC witness for scope-bound admissibility

orsc_projection.residual: previous explanation no longer covers revised official data
orsc_projection.ordered_next_step: hydrate predecessor receipt and construct revised link
orsc_projection.evidence_gate: predecessor receipt, revision evidence, and attribution authority envelope must exist before revising a memory candidate

aem_sub_capability_field_derivations.pressure_target: AEM-4 target: block narrative backfitting and pseudo-causality before promotion
field_pressure_observations: without score component trace, confidence cannot be decomposed or challenged
without placebo and control-window evidence, overfit narrative risk cannot be tested
without alternative and negative evidence penalties, selective causality cannot be penalized
without anti-bias review receipt, promotion cannot prove bias review occurred
without an anti-bias authority envelope, the review step has no ORSC witness for allowed review boundary

orsc_projection.residual: candidate explanation may be an overfit narrative
orsc_projection.ordered_next_step: apply score trace and placebo/control review before promotion
orsc_projection.evidence_gate: anti-bias evidence, review receipt, and anti-bias authority envelope must exist before promotion

aem_sub_capability_field_derivations.pressure_target: AEM-5 target: decide promotion, downgrade, deferral, or denial without opening memory write authority
field_pressure_observations: without checklist and blocker evidence, promotion or denial cannot be justified
without downgrade, deferral, and denial reasons, non-promotion decisions cannot be audited
without decision actor and time refs, disposition lineage is incomplete
without a promotion decision receipt, the disposition step cannot be replayed
without a disposition authority envelope, memory promotion has no ORSC witness and may be misread as runtime authorization

orsc_projection.residual: candidate memory exists but admissibility is unsettled
orsc_projection.ordered_next_step: evaluate promotion checklist under scope-bound admissibility
orsc_projection.evidence_gate: blocker evidence, promotion decision receipt, and disposition authority envelope are required before disposition

aem_sub_capability_field_derivations.pressure_target: AEM-6 target: support future reuse while preserving non-authorizing boundaries
field_pressure_observations: without prior memory and prior receipt refs, reuse cannot prove what is being reused
without current and reuse context refs, semantic resemblance may be mistaken for scope compatibility
without context mismatch and denied-scope fields, inadmissible reuse cannot be explained
without a reuse boundary receipt, reuse cannot be audited as a bounded non-authorizing step
without a reuse authority envelope and non-authorizing statement, future reuse may be misread as runtime authorization

orsc_projection.residual: new event resembles prior memory but scope may differ
orsc_projection.ordered_next_step: hydrate prior receipt before reuse and check scope
orsc_projection.evidence_gate: prior receipt, context match evidence, reuse receipt, and reuse authority envelope must exist before reuse
